doc: Send an event to one or more channels. Every browser with a Hibira Channel element on those channels gets it.

AYa.caption: Channels
AYa.doc: One channel, or several separated by commas (at most 100).
AYa.name: channels

AYc.caption: Data
AYc.doc: JSON such as {"status": "shipped"}, or plain text (sent as {"text": ...}). Ignored when Data fields is filled in.
AYc.name: data

AYd.caption: Data fields
AYd.doc: Optional. Key/value pairs sent as a JSON object, instead of Data.
AYd.name: data_fields

AYe.caption: Skip socket ID
AYe.doc: Optional. A Hibira Channel's Socket ID: that browser won't get its own event.
AYe.name: socket_id
